name: Mahlkoenig E64 WebSocket Sensor
author: Decaid contributors
description: Opt-in read-only E64 telemetry over the local WebSocket protocol.

InstancesJson.label: E64 instances
InstancesJson.description: JSON array of grinder id, name, scheme, host, port, and optional pollMs values.

TokensJson.label: E64 session tokens
TokensJson.description: JSON object mapping each configured grinder id to its WebSocket session token.
